rows.label: qst500107_msg0001
rows.name: Hello, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm busy excavating all the ruins
here, so please come back later, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0003
rows.name: What now?

rows.label: qst500107_msg0004
rows.name: Leave for later

rows.label: qst500107_msg0005
rows.name: Keep talking

rows.label: qst500107_msg0006
rows.name:
I like people who understand quickly,
mo.

rows.label: qst500107_msg0007
rows.name:
Nonnon said Nonnon is busy, mo!
Why do you keep talking, mo?!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0008
rows.name:
I want to excavate every ruin here
and obtain Divine Beast weapons like
Aeshma, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0009
rows.name:
It would take over 100 years to dig
all this up alone, so I can't waste
even a moment, mo.

rows.label: qst500107_msg0010
rows.name:
Now that you understand, please
leave right away, mo.

rows.label: qst500107_msg0011
rows.name: What will you do?

rows.label: qst500107_msg0012
rows.name: Encourage Nonnon

rows.label: qst500107_msg0013
rows.name: Stop Nonnon

rows.label: qst500107_msg0014
rows.name: Thanks for the encouragement, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0015
rows.name:
If I uncover a Divine Beast weapon,
you'll be the first to know, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0016
rows.name: Nobody can stop Nonnon, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0017
rows.name: Not my parents, not my siblings...

rows.label: qst500107_msg0018
rows.name:
Huh? Nonnon feels like Nonnon had
siblings, mo...

rows.label: qst500107_msg0019
rows.name: And twelve of them...

rows.label: qst500107_msg0020
rows.name: That's right, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0021
rows.name:
Nonnon came to Temperantia to look
for delicious juice ingredients, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0022
rows.name:
I was supposed to help develop new
menu items for the Twelve Nopon
Siblings in Avaritia, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0023
rows.name:
But I found the ruins and got so
absorbed that I kept digging, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0024
rows.name: What a blunder, mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0025
rows.name:
Now I need to find a Death Mushroom
and take it back as soon as possible,
mo!

rows.label: qst500107_msg0026
rows.name: Thanks for stopping Nonnon, mooo!
